name: Modus
description: Builds a reviewed, source-linked Markdown knowledge base of your codebase for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and CodeBuddy, so coding agents find the code and tests behind business rules.

skills.name: Initialize Project Knowledge
skills.description: Builds traceable project knowledge from current source, tests, configs and attached requirements or design documents, with /modus-init.

skills.name: Update Knowledge
skills.description: Updates the project knowledge affected by new material or local facts, without rerunning repository-wide analysis.

skills.name: Reorganize Knowledge
skills.description: Reviews and reorganizes existing project knowledge while keeping stable domain and module identities, with /modus-reinit.

skills.name: Connect a Project
skills.description: Installs Modus skills and commands into a repository for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or CodeBuddy with the modus init command.
